approved_payload.content: A taxi driver was shot dead and two other people were wounded at the Esangweni taxi rank in Tembisa at about 05:00 on Tuesday 27 October, according to police. Police say five unknown men approached the victim, two of them armed with 9mm firearms, and opened fire; the two wounded were taken to hospital and the men fled on foot. The motive is unknown and no arrests had been made. No one is named. Tembisa South police station. One source, the SAPS Gauteng statement of 27 October; the only news coverage found was in Caxton papers, which are not used. The map point is approximate: the mapped Esangweni taxi rank, not a confirmed spot.
